title: Sameday AI Alternatives for Service Businesses
seo_title: Sameday AI Alternatives: Compare Options & Fit
description: Compare Sameday AI alternatives for home services. Off The Clock AI, Avoca, Jobber and ServiceTitan: monthly costs, scheduling and job quotes.
intro: Getting a customer onto the calendar is one outcome. Giving them the job price before the conversation ends is another.
verdict: Choose Off The Clock for an operator that handles the price conversation as well as answering and booking. QuoteDone pairs your rates with the job details and gives website visitors another way to get started.
reason: Sameday sells more than basic answering: its product range includes phones, connected scheduling, campaigns and coaching. The purchase combines call handling with office tools. QuoteDone’s addition is the owner-priced job itself. [[sameday-product]]

Its Launch plan starts at $449 per month with 500 minutes; Scale starts at $789 with 1,000. Off The Clock’s QuoteDone offer is $279 with 1,200 minutes. The allowances are directly stated; their location, coaching and campaign inclusions differ. [[sameday-pricing]]

For a business whose recurring task is preparing the quote after someone else answered the call, the important addition is QuoteDone. The operator handles the customer interaction; the pricing uses the owner’s rules rather than leaving a second conversation for the owner.
choices: The operator, job pricing and website quoting

QuoteDone includes the operator and website quote widget in the same $279 offer. Customers can ask business questions, get a supported job priced, move into booking or reach your team. Missing facts go to review rather than being hidden inside a price.
Call oversight and an external human program

Avoca’s Coach provides scoring and reporting, and its Human in the Loop program supplies trained CSRs. Human-program availability and cost belong in the proposal; they are not assumed to accompany every Avoca module. [[avoca-coach]] [[avoca-human]]

The Receptionist add-on is $29 for 30 conversations on eligible plans, with $0.79 per additional conversation. That is an incremental Jobber feature with a different billing unit, not an entire standalone operator-and-quoting subscription. [[jobber-help]]

Voice Agent uses ServiceTitan job types and account context. Its indexed public offer is $2.75 per call; the underlying software cost is separate. The distinction is native account access, not a directly comparable minute allowance. [[st-pricing]] [[st-settings]]
decision: Choose Off The Clock when you want the incoming inquiry to reach the job price, not stop at a booking request. You get the operator and QuoteDone together, with a clear monthly offer and your own pricing in control.
faqs: Is Sameday only an answering service?

No. Its current product pages include a phone system, scheduling, campaigns and coaching. QuoteDone’s case is the owner-priced job and website quoting experience, alongside the complete operator. [[sameday-product]]
Are the quoted plan amounts a total-cost guarantee?

No. They are the displayed starting packages. Sameday’s chosen configuration and usage terms, and each product’s billing currency, taxes and applicable extras, determine the actual bill. The amounts shown have not been converted between currencies.
card_description: Compare Sameday’s $449 and $789 starting plans with QuoteDone’s $279 offer, native scheduling options and Avoca’s front-office products.
sections: What the published numbers tell you

At the listed starting amounts, QuoteDone is $170 below Sameday Launch and $510 below Scale per month, with 700 and 200 more included minutes respectively. Additional QuoteDone usage is $0.35 per minute. These are package differences, not a projection of anyone’s actual bill. [[sameday-pricing]]

Launch includes three locations and Scale lists unlimited locations and voice cloning. Those inclusions explain why comparing only subscription prices would be incomplete. Compare the capabilities you need, then count the quote preparation that still falls to you. [[sameday-pricing]]
One inquiry should not create two conversations

For a mulch installation, a customer’s measured bed area and depth describe a different job from an unspecified “load of mulch.” Preparation and edging can change the scope again. QuoteDone uses the supported measurements and selected items with your own pricing.

The point is not a more elaborate intake form. It is a customer who understands the supported job price without you rebuilding the request later. The same pricing approach belongs on the website, not only on the phone.
